messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Telugu, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

**Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition for Telugu** | Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement (Telugu) | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------| | Ahi | Exclamation of emotional intensity | **అయ్యో** — interjection, no inflection.
**BT:** “Ah!” | | quanto | Degree adverb marking “how” (extent of difficulty) | **ఎంత** — interrogative‑adverb, degree‑neutral.
**BT:** “how” | | a | Preposition introducing infinitive “to” | **చెప్పడానికి** — infinitival marker **‑డానికి** attached to verb root **చెప్పు**; non‑finite, neutral aspect.
**BT:** “to tell” | | dir | Verb “to tell” in infinitive form | **చెప్పు** — verb root, combined with **‑డానికి** above; lexical verb “tell”.
**BT:** “tell” | | qual | Interrogative pronoun “what” referring to the unknown entity | **ఏది** — neuter interrogative pronoun, nominative/accusative case.
**BT:** “what” | | era | Past imperfect copula “was” (state of the forest) | **ఉన్నది** — past‑imperfect form of **ఉండు** (to be), third‑person singular, neuter.
**BT:** “was” | | è | Present copula “is” (asserting hardness) | **అది** — demonstrative pronoun used as copula, present tense, third‑person singular.
**BT:** “is” | | cosa | Noun “thing” (the referent) | **వస్తువు** — common‑gender noun, nominative, singular.
**BT:** “thing” | | dura | Adjective “hard” with explicit degree “very” | **చాలా కఠినమైన** — degree adverb **చాలా** (very) + adjective **కఠినమైన** (hard), attributive, agrees in gender‑number with **వస్తువు**.
**BT:** “hard” | | esta | Demonstrative adjective “this” (pointing to the forest) | **ఈ** — proximal demonstrative adjective, agrees with **అడవి** (feminine singular).
**BT:** “this” | | selva | Noun “forest / wood” | **అడవి** — feminine noun, nominative, singular.
**BT:** “forest” | | selvaggia | Adjective “wild” (first in the adjective chain) | **అరణ్య** — attributive adjective, placed before noun, agrees in gender‑number; ordering 1️⃣.
**BT:** “wild” | | e (1) | Coordinating conjunction “and” linking adjectives | **మరియు** — coordinating conjunction, no inflection.
**BT:** “and” | | aspra | Adjective “rough” (second in the chain) | **ముడి** — attributive adjective, placed after the first adjective, agrees in gender‑number; ordering 2️⃣.
**BT:** “rough” | | e (2) | Coordinating conjunction “and” linking adjectives | **మరియు** — same as above.
**BT:** “and” | | forte | Adjective “dense / strong” (third in the chain) | **సాంద్ర** — attributive adjective, placed after the second adjective, agrees in gender‑number; ordering 3️⃣.
**BT:** “dense” | | che | Relative pronoun “which / that” referring back to the forest | **అది** — relative pronoun, nominative, singular, introduces relative clause.
**BT:** “which” | | nel | Prepositional phrase “in the” (locative) | **లో** — locative case suffix attached to **ఆలోచన** (see next).
**BT:** “in the” | | pensier | Noun “thought / mind” (object of the locative) | **ఆలోచన** — feminine noun, singular; combined with **లో** to form **ఆలోచనలో** (in thought).
**BT:** “thought” | | rinova | Verb “renews / recreates” (present, 3sg) | **పునరుద్ధరిస్తుంది** — present‑indicative, third‑person singular, transitive, aspectual imperfective.
**BT:** “renews” | | la | Definite article “the” (not lexical in Telugu; rendered as demonstrative) | **ఆ** — demonstrative adjective, agrees with **భయం**; functions as definite article.
**BT:** “the” | | paura | Noun “fear” (direct object of “renews”) | **భయం** — feminine noun, accusative (object of verb), singular.
**BT:** “fear” | | ! | Exclamation mark (punctuation) | **!** — punctuation, no morphosyntax.
**BT:** (exclamation) | *Notes on comparative ordering & degree:* - The adjective chain **అరణ్య ముడి సాంద్ర** follows the explicit ordering required by the source (wild → rough → dense). - The degree adverb **చాలా** explicitly marks the intensity of **కఠినమైన** (“hard”), satisfying the “comparative ordering + degree” requirement.

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 4: అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పడానికి ఏమి ఉండేది అది చాలా కఠినమైన విషయం / అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పాలి అది చాలా కఠినమైన విషయం / అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పడానికి అది చాలా కఠినమైనది - Line 5: ఈ అడవి అరణ్య ముడి సాంద్ర / ఈ అడవి అరణ్యమైన ముడి సాంద్ర / ఈ అడవి అరణ్య ముడి సాంద్రమైన - Line 6: అది ఆలోచనలో భయాన్ని పునరుద్ధరిస్తుంది / అది ఆలోచనలో భయాన్ని పునరుద్ధరించుతుంది / అది ఆలోచనలో భయాన్ని పునరుద్ధరించెను

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Telugu lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 4 Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura
**Line Inventory:** - అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పడానికి ఏమి ఉండేది అది చాలా కఠినమైన విషయం
**Assembly Notes:** - Added only the end‑exclamation punctuation “!” (no lexical content added).
**Target Text:** అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పడానికి ఏమి ఉండేది అది చాలా కఠినమైన విషయం!
**Source Line:** 5 esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte
**Line Inventory:** - ఈ అడవి అరణ్య ముడి సాంద్ర
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function words required; the phrase already contains the demonstrative “ఈ” and the noun‑adjective sequence.
**Target Text:** ఈ అడవి అరణ్య ముడి సాంద్ర
**Source Line:** 6 che nel pensier rinova la paura!
**Line Inventory:** - అది ఆలోచనలో భయాన్ని పునరుద్ధరిస్తుంది
**Assembly Notes:** - Added the end‑exclamation punctuation “!” to match the source’s terminal mark.
**Target Text:** అది ఆలోచనలో భయాన్ని పునరుద్ధరిస్తుంది!

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line #4 Target Text: అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పడానికి ఏమి ఉండేది అది చాలా కఠినమైన విషయం! Back-Translation: “Ah, how to tell what it was, it is a very hard thing.” Reference Translation: “Ah! how hard a thing it is to tell what this wild and rough and dense wood was” Checks: End Punct **FAIL**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK** Corrected Target Text: అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పడానికి ఏమి ఉండేది అది చాలా కఠినమైన విషయం
- Line #5 Target Text: ఈ అడవి అరణ్య ముడి సాంద్ర Back-Translation: “this forest wild rough dense” Reference Translation: “this wild and rough and dense wood” Checks: End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **OK**, Hallucination **OK** Corrected Target Text: (none)
- Line #6 Target Text: అది ఆలోచనలో భయాన్ని పునరుద్ధరిస్తుంది! Back-Translation: “it renews the fear in thought!” Reference Translation: “which in thought renews the fear!” Checks: End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK** Corrected Target Text: (none)
``` అయ్యో ఎంత చెప్పడానికి ఏమి ఉండేది అది చాలా కఠినమైన విషయం ఈ అడవి అరణ్య ముడి సాంద్ర అది ఆలోచనలో భయాన్ని పునరుద్ధరిస్తుంది! ```
